description: Sends one event bound to the exact displayed frame and returns the next exact frame. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

input.description: One pointer, key, scroll, resize, or close event from the closed interaction vocabulary.

name: send_exploration_input
